package student

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// GetLearningActionContext returns the safe, frozen task context owned by one
// student. Missing and foreign actions remain indistinguishable.
type GetLearningActionContext struct {
	Actions repository.LearningActionReader
}

func (useCase GetLearningActionContext) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	learningActionID string,
) (domain.LearningActionContext, error) {
	if useCase.Actions == nil {
		return domain.LearningActionContext{}, fmt.Errorf("learning action reader is required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(learningActionID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	action, err := useCase.Actions.GetByStudentAndID(ctx, studentID, learningActionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionContext{}, err
	}
	if action.StudentID != studentID || action.ID != learningActionID {
		return domain.LearningActionContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result, err := domain.NewLearningActionContext(action)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionContext{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid stored learning action context", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return result, nil
}
